subject: HealthSync kickoff: attendee stewardship & preflight links
messages:
From: Miriam Lopez <miriam@healthsync.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@healthsync.com>, Tina Ng <tina.ng@healthsync.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: HealthSync kickoff — intake and logistics

Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to schedule a formal kickoff to align owners, calendar invites, and any prework we should complete before SSO and data access work begins. Key asks from our side:

- A 60–75 minute kickoff (recorded) covering roles, security checklist, and first 30-day milestones.
- Attendee roster: Product PM, Dev lead, SRE, Security contact, Procurement. I'll list proposed attendees below.
- Any documents or preflight items you want us to complete (questionnaire, access inventory, SSO details).

Proposed attendees (HealthSync):
- Miriam Lopez — Product Lead (miriam@healthsync.com)
- Arjun Patel — Dev Lead (arjun.patel@healthsync.com)
- Tina Ng — Procurement (tina.ng@healthsync.com)
- (optional) John Kim — Security (john.kim@healthsync.com)

Availability windows (PDT) for kickoff week (June 1–5):
- Tue Jun 2: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed Jun 3: 09:00–11:00
- Thu Jun 4: 13:00–16:00

I've attached our intake questionnaire and a short SSO inventory to speed things up. Can you propose 2–3 slots and a short draft agenda?

Thanks,
Miriam Lopez
Product Lead, HealthSync
attachments: healthsync-preflight-questionnaire.pdf, sso-inventory.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Miriam Lopez <miriam@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: HealthSync kickoff — intake and logistics

Hi Miriam —

Appreciate the clear availability and the attachments. We can take this on. Proposed slots (we'll host a Zoom + record, and I will create the calendar invite once you confirm):

- Tue Jun 2, 15:30–16:45 ET (12:30–13:45 PT) — preferred, gives us time to prep with internal leads
- Wed Jun 3, 09:30–10:45 ET (06:30–07:45 PT) — early but doable
- Thu Jun 4, 14:00–15:15 ET (11:00–12:15 PT) — alternate

Draft agenda (attached as redwood-kickoff-agenda-draft.docx):
1) Introductions & roles (10m) — owners and primary contacts
2) Success criteria & 30-day milestones (10m)
3) Technical footprint: SSO, network & data access, PCI/GDPR considerations (20m)
4) Implementation plan: sprints, rollouts, testing cadence (15m)
5) Action items & owners, next steps (10m)

Internal owners I've put on the invite:
- Grace O'Connor — CS Lead (owner of kickoff and success criteria)
- Marissa Cole — Implementation PM (sprint planning and tasks)
- Ben Carter — Onboarding Engineer (technical walkthroughs, SSO prep)

Preflight asks for HealthSync (so we can use the session effectively):
- Complete the attached questionnaire and the SSO configuration sheet (SSO guide attached).
- Provide a network diagram or list of IPs that will need egress access.
- Identify the person who will approve procurement/order forms (Tina?).

Proposed calendar invite/Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Google Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cHealthSyncOnboard
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-2026-043

I'll attach the agenda and the SSO configuration guide to the invite. Please confirm which slot works and whether John Kim (Security) should be on the call.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0192
attachments: redwood-kickoff-agenda-draft.docx, sso-configuration-guide.xlsx

Hey all —

I can take the Wed Jun 3 slot if that works for HealthSync — gives our eng team a chance to finish a short preflight checklist. Ben, can you prepare a 10–12 minute walkthrough of the SSO flow and the minimal network requirements? I'll own the milestones slide and the 30-day deliverable list.

Also, if Procurement (Tina) prefers a separate 15-minute procurement sync immediately after the kickoff to walk through PO and timing, we can add it as an optional follow-up.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Implementation PM | Redwood Inference

John Kim (security) will join if we need deeper compliance discussion, otherwise optional. Tina would like the 15-minute procurement follow-up right after the main meeting (10:50–11:05 ET) — she will stay on the bridge.

Best,
Miriam
